about: The style showcase on the homepage (docs/site/styles/): the groups, by what the picture looks like, and each style's words. tools/style_site.py (bin/vh style site) builds the pages from this file, tokens.json and the samples. A blank the reader fills in is written [like this] in English and 〔像这样〕 in Chinese.

line.en: Cut out or printed: a few flat colours, paper edges, halftone dots.
line.zh: 像剪出来、印出来的：几块平涂的颜色、纸边和网点。

line.en: Ink, paint and carved hide, with the marks of the hand left in.
line.zh: 墨、颜料和皮影，看得见手留下的痕迹。

line.en: The picture is a figure: axes, symbols, line work and dimensions.
line.zh: 画面就是一张图：坐标、符号、线稿和尺寸。

line.en: Things you would see on a screen: a terminal, an interface, a game, the web.
line.zh: 像屏幕上的东西：终端、界面、游戏和网页。

line.en: Mostly darkness, lit in a few places: neon, lamps in fog, type scratched into film.
line.zh: 大片的黑里只亮几处：霓虹、雾里的灯、刮在胶片上的字。

line.en: Volume, material and light: props on a table, brass machines, a wall of photos, a landscape to walk into.
line.zh: 有体积、有材质、有光：桌上的小道具、黄铜机械、照片墙、能走进去的风景。

what.en: Saul Bass's cut-paper titles: a few paper colours, scissor edges, a cut on every brass hit.
what.zh: Saul Bass 的剪纸片头：几种纸色、剪刀边，铜管每记重音就是一刀。

for.en: Title-sequence openings for an idea or a product.
for.zh: 概念或产品的片头式开场。

ask.en: Make a 20-second title sequence for [your product] in the cut-paper jazz style (styles/cutout-jazz).
ask.zh: 用剪纸爵士片头风格（styles/cutout-jazz）给〔你的产品〕做一段 20 秒的片头。

what.en: Two or three spot colours printed over each other and never quite in register, with a Risograph's grain.
what.zh: 两三种专色叠在一起印，永远套不准，带着孔版印刷的颗粒。

for.en: Warm, independent stories that feel handmade.
for.zh: 温暖、独立、有手作感的故事。

ask.en: Make a 40-second film about [a small shop] in the Risograph style (styles/risograph).
ask.zh: 用孔版印刷风格（styles/risograph）做一支 40 秒的短片，讲〔一家小店〕。

what.en: Halftone dots instead of gradients, colours printed off-register on purpose, drawn on twos, as in Spider-Verse.
what.zh: 网点代替渐变，套色故意不准，一拍二地动，像《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》。

for.en: Fast pieces with a lot of action.
for.zh: 动作感强、节奏快的内容。

ask.en: Make a fast 20-second film about [one moment] in the halftone comic style (styles/halftone-comic).
ask.zh: 用半调漫画风格（styles/halftone-comic）做一支 20 秒的快节奏短片，讲〔一个瞬间〕。

what.en: Layers of cut-paper silhouettes moving in parallax at 12 frames a second, as in The Adventures of Prince Achmed.
what.zh: 几层剪纸剪影前后错开，每秒 12 格地动，像《阿赫迈德王子历险记》。

for.en: Fairy tales, fables, folk stories.
for.zh: 童话、寓言、民间故事。

ask.en: Tell [a fairy tale] in 60 seconds in the silhouette papercut style (styles/silhouette-papercut).
ask.zh: 用剪影剪纸风格（styles/silhouette-papercut）讲〔一个童话〕，60 秒。

what.en: Gold line on red, big bold Song type, patterns unrolling beat by beat, with the cheer of a woodblock New Year print.
what.zh: 红底金线、粗宋大字，纹样一拍一拍铺开，木版年画的喜气。

for.en: Festivals, launches with a Chinese look, the first seconds of a vertical video.
for.zh: 节日、国风发布、竖屏的开头。

ask.en: Make a 15-second vertical film for [a festival event] in the guochao style (styles/guochao-festive).
ask.zh: 用国潮风格（styles/guochao-festive）给〔一个节日活动〕做一支 15 秒的竖屏短片。

what.en: A visible grid, one sans-serif family, red, black and white, set like a Swiss concert poster.
what.zh: 看得见的网格、一套无衬线字、红黑白三色，像瑞士音乐会海报那样排。

for.en: Rules, processes, timelines, manifestos.
for.zh: 规则、流程、时间线、宣言。

ask.en: Turn [a set of rules] into 30 seconds of moving type in the Swiss grid style (styles/swiss-grid-type).
ask.zh: 用瑞士网格动态字风格（styles/swiss-grid-type）把〔一套规则〕做成 30 秒的动态字。

what.en: Four colours on a bright ground; flat shapes act by squashing and stretching, in the UPA tradition.
what.zh: 亮底四色，几何形状靠挤压拉伸来演戏，UPA 动画那一路。

for.en: Light-hearted explainers, little app skits.
for.zh: 轻松的知识短片、App 小剧场。

ask.en: Make a light 30-second film about [a small fact] in the bouncy flat 2D style (styles/bouncy-flat-2d).
ask.zh: 用弹性扁平 2D 风格（styles/bouncy-flat-2d）做一支 30 秒的轻松短片，讲〔一个小知识〕。

what.en: A drop of ink spreads into distant mountains on a page left mostly empty, in the brushwork of Shanghai's ink-wash animation.
what.zh: 一滴墨晕开成远山，大片留白，上海美影水墨动画的笔墨。

for.en: Fables, quiet reflections, traditional culture.
for.zh: 寓言、哲思、传统文化。

ask.en: Tell [a fable] in 40 seconds in the ink-wash style (styles/ink-wash).
ask.zh: 用水墨风格（styles/ink-wash）讲〔一个寓言〕，40 秒。

what.en: Wet-on-wet skies and wind running through the grass in waves, countryside like a Ghibli background.
what.zh: 湿画法的天空，风一波一波吹过草地，吉卜力背景那样的田园。

for.en: Gentle pieces, seasons and nature, slow music videos.
for.zh: 治愈系、季节和自然、慢歌 MV。

ask.en: Make a 45-second film about [a season] in the watercolour pastoral style (styles/watercolor-pastoral).
ask.zh: 用水彩田园风格（styles/watercolor-pastoral）做一支 45 秒的短片，讲〔一个季节〕。

what.en: Mineral pigments, fine even line work and the long ribbons of flying apsaras, from the Mogao cave murals.
what.zh: 矿物颜料的颜色、铁线描的线、飞天的长飘带，取自莫高窟壁画。

for.en: The Silk Road, history, stories told like a scroll.
for.zh: 丝路、历史、横卷式的叙事。

ask.en: Tell [a Silk Road story] in 60 seconds in the Dunhuang mural style (styles/dunhuang-mural).
ask.zh: 用敦煌风格（styles/dunhuang-mural）讲〔一段丝路上的故事〕，60 秒。

what.en: Jointed leather puppets on three rods, against a cloth screen lit by an oil lamp.
what.zh: 油灯照亮的布幕上，带关节的皮影由三根签子操纵。

for.en: Folk tales, opera, what happens behind the screen.
for.zh: 民间故事、戏曲、台前幕后。

ask.en: Tell [a folk tale] in 45 seconds in the shadow puppetry style (styles/shadow-puppet).
ask.zh: 用皮影风格（styles/shadow-puppet）讲〔一个民间故事〕，45 秒。

what.en: Pastel frames built on a centre line, a new colour for each chapter, chapter cards and whip pans, as in Wes Anderson's films.
what.zh: 中轴对称的粉彩画面，每章换一种颜色，配章节字卡和甩镜，像韦斯·安德森的电影。

for.en: Lightly funny explainers, short portraits of a person.
for.zh: 带点幽默的知识短片、人物小传。

ask.en: Make a 60-second portrait of [a person] in the symmetry pastel style (styles/symmetry-pastel).
ask.zh: 用对称粉彩绘本风格（styles/symmetry-pastel）做一支 60 秒的人物小传，讲〔一个人〕。

what.en: The headline is the finding; the chart is grey with one accent colour, as in New York Times graphics.
what.zh: 标题就是结论，图里只有灰和一个强调色，像《纽约时报》的数据图。

for.en: Data journalism, research findings.
for.zh: 数据新闻、研究结果。

ask.en: Turn [a dataset] into a 45-second film in the editorial data style (styles/editorial-data), with the finding as the headline.
ask.zh: 用编辑部数据叙事风格（styles/editorial-data）把〔一组数据〕做成 45 秒的短片，标题就是结论。

what.en: One bubble chart is the stage and time can run forward or back, as when Hans Rosling told 200 countries in four minutes.
what.zh: 一张气泡图就是舞台，时间能快进、能倒回，像汉斯·罗斯林四分钟讲完 200 个国家。

for.en: How a group of things changes over time.
for.zh: 一群东西随时间怎么变。

ask.en: Show how [a set of countries or companies] changed over the decades, in 60 seconds, in the bubble chart story style (styles/bubble-chart-story).
ask.zh: 用气泡图现场讲风格（styles/bubble-chart-story）讲〔一组国家或公司〕这几十年怎么变，60 秒。

what.en: One symbol stands for a fixed amount; more means more symbols, added or taken away on the beat.
what.zh: 一个符号代表固定的数量，多就多排几个，在拍点上加一个、减一个。

for.en: Counting things: people, resources, proportions.
for.zh: 人口、资源、比例这类计数。

ask.en: Turn [a set of numbers] into a 30-second film in the Isotype style (styles/isotype).
ask.zh: 用图形统计风格（styles/isotype）把〔一组数量〕做成 30 秒的短片。

what.en: White lines on blue, drawn in the order a draughtsman would, with dimensions that change as the parts move.
what.zh: 蓝底白线，按制图的顺序一笔笔画出来，尺寸跟着零件实时变。

for.en: Structures, mechanisms, system architecture.
for.zh: 结构、机制、系统架构。

ask.en: Draw the structure of [a system] in 45 seconds in the blueprint style (styles/blueprint).
ask.zh: 用工程蓝图风格（styles/blueprint）画出〔一个系统〕的结构，45 秒。

what.en: The idea becomes a small isometric machine that comes apart: solid parts, four tones of shade, one part lit at a time.
what.zh: 把概念做成一台能拆开的等轴小机器，零件实心、四阶明暗，一次只点亮一个部件。

for.en: Mechanisms, systems and methods, how a product is built, teardowns.
for.zh: 机制、系统和方法、产品构造、拆解。

ask.en: Take [a system] apart in 45 seconds in the iso anatomy style (styles/iso-anatomy).
ask.zh: 用等轴解剖风格（styles/iso-anatomy）把〔一个系统〕拆开讲，45 秒。

what.en: Pure black, one colour for each mathematical object, the way 3Blue1Brown explains.
what.zh: 纯黑底，每个数学对象一个颜色，3Blue1Brown 的讲法。

for.en: Principles, theorems, algorithms.
for.zh: 原理、定理、算法讲解。

ask.en: Make a 60-second explainer in the dark math style (styles/dark-math): why [a theorem] is true.
ask.zh: 用暗底数学风格（styles/dark-math）做一支 60 秒的讲解：〔一个定理〕为什么成立。

what.en: A one-colour phosphor screen and monospaced text, typed out character by character with a glow that lingers.
what.zh: 单色荧光屏、等宽字符，一个字一个字打出来，带余辉。

for.en: Code, hacking, system logs.
for.zh: 代码、黑客、系统日志。

ask.en: Make a 30-second film about [what a piece of code does] in the CRT terminal style (styles/crt-terminal).
ask.zh: 用 CRT 终端风格（styles/crt-terminal）做一支 30 秒的短片，讲〔一段代码在做什么〕。

what.en: Dot grids, hairlines and monospaced readouts, like the screens in films, and every readout is real data.
what.zh: 点阵、发丝线、等宽读数，像电影里的屏幕界面，每个读数都是真数据。

for.en: Systems, monitoring, the view from inside an agent.
for.zh: 系统、监测、agent 的内部视角。

ask.en: Make a 30-second film of [a system] at work in the film FUI / HUD style (styles/fui-hud).
ask.zh: 用电影界面 HUD 风格（styles/fui-hud）做一支 30 秒的短片，展示〔一个系统〕在运行。

what.en: White rounded cards on a pastel wash, one colour per idea from start to end; things get typed, sent and ticked.
what.zh: 粉彩底上的白色圆角卡片，一个概念一个颜色从头带到尾，东西被打出来、发出去、打上勾。

for.en: Walking through a process, onboarding for an app or SaaS.
for.zh: 过程讲解、App 和 SaaS 的上手引导。

ask.en: Explain [a process] in 45 seconds in the pastel UI style (styles/pastel-ui).
ask.zh: 用浅色界面讲解风格（styles/pastel-ui）讲〔一个流程〕，45 秒。

what.en: A 320 × 180 frame scaled up in whole steps, a fixed 24-colour palette, dialogue typed out letter by letter, mosaic transitions.
what.zh: 320 × 180 的画面整数倍放大，固定 24 色，对话框逐字打出，马赛克转场。

for.en: Telling something as a game: levels, an inventory, save points.
for.zh: 把一件事讲成游戏系统：升级、背包、存档。

ask.en: Turn [learning something] into a 40-second game level in the 16-bit pixel style (styles/pixel-16bit).
ask.zh: 用 16 位像素风格（styles/pixel-16bit）把〔学一样东西〕讲成一关游戏，40 秒。

what.en: System fonts, a bare grid and a hard cut on every beat: the internet's own rough look.
what.zh: 系统字、裸网格，每一拍一刀硬切，网上野生审美那一路。

for.en: Meme videos, fast edits about tech.
for.zh: 梗视频、科技圈的快剪。

ask.en: Cut [a tech story] into a 15-second edit in the brutalist meme style (styles/brutalist-meme).
ask.zh: 用野兽派梗风格（styles/brutalist-meme）把〔一条科技新闻〕剪成 15 秒的快剪。

what.en: Huge forms standing in layers of fog, and very few words, at the scale of Blade Runner 2049 and Arrival.
what.zh: 巨大的形体立在层层雾里，字极少，《银翼杀手 2049》《降临》那种尺度。

for.en: Teasers before a launch, stories about the future, title cards.
for.zh: 发布前的 teaser、未来题材、片名。

ask.en: Make a 30-second teaser for [what you're launching] in the monumental sci-fi style (styles/monumental-scifi).
ask.zh: 用纪念碑科幻风格（styles/monumental-scifi）给〔你要发布的东西〕做一支 30 秒的 teaser。

what.en: Step-printing smears the lights into streaks, red against green, the camera handheld and close: Wong Kar-wai's nights.
what.zh: 抽帧把灯拉成光带，红绿互补，镜头贴身手持，王家卫电影里的夜。

for.en: City nights, music videos built on a mood.
for.zh: 城市夜景、情绪 MV。

ask.en: Make a 30-second music video for [a song] in the neon step-print style (styles/neon-step-print).
ask.zh: 用霓虹抽帧风格（styles/neon-step-print）给〔一首歌〕做一段 30 秒的 MV。

what.en: Letters scratched into the film itself, jittering frame by frame, as in the Se7en titles.
what.zh: 字像是刮在胶片上的，一格一格地抖，《七宗罪》片头那一路。

for.en: Thrillers, crime stories, industrial music videos.
for.zh: 悬疑、犯罪题材、工业噪音类 MV。

ask.en: Make a 30-second opening for [a mystery story] in the scratched-type style (styles/scratched-type).
ask.zh: 用刮擦字片头风格（styles/scratched-type）给〔一个悬疑故事〕做一段 30 秒的片头。

what.en: A striped sunset, a neon perspective grid, chrome letters and the texture of videotape: an arcade night in the 1980s.
what.zh: 条纹落日、霓虹透视网格、铬字，带录像带的质感，80 年代街机的夜。

for.en: Retro tech, games, openings with a strong beat.
for.zh: 复古科技、游戏、节拍强的片头。

ask.en: Make a 20-second opening for [a game] in the synthwave outrun style (styles/synthwave-outrun).
ask.zh: 用合成器浪潮风格（styles/synthwave-outrun）给〔一款游戏〕做一段 20 秒的片头。

what.en: A real tabletop is the stage: little geometric characters act on twos, and the colour and angle of the light tell the time.
what.zh: 一张真实的桌面当舞台，几何体小角色一拍二地演，光的颜色和方向就是时间。

for.en: Short character pieces, little product skits.
for.zh: 角色小短片、产品小剧场。

ask.en: Make a 40-second short about [a small story] in the tabletop miniature style (styles/tabletop-miniature).
ask.zh: 用桌面微缩剧场风格（styles/tabletop-miniature）做一支 40 秒的小短片，讲〔一个小故事〕。

what.en: Every place on the map is a brass machine pushed up out of the ground by cogs, as in the Game of Thrones titles.
what.zh: 地图上的每个地点都是被齿轮顶出地面的黄铜机械，像《权力的游戏》片头。

for.en: Routes, territories, how several places connect.
for.zh: 路线、版图、几个地点之间的关系。

ask.en: Make a 45-second film about [a route] in the clockwork map style (styles/clockwork-map).
ask.zh: 用机械钟表地图风格（styles/clockwork-map）做一支 45 秒的短片，讲〔一条路线〕。

what.en: A seamless backdrop; the product settles first, then the words arrive, at the pace of an Apple launch film.
what.zh: 无缝背景前，产品先落稳，字再出来，苹果发布片的节奏。

for.en: Hardware and software launches, feature highlights.
for.zh: 软硬件发布、功能亮点。

ask.en: Make a 30-second launch film for [your product] in the product keynote style (styles/product-keynote).
ask.zh: 用产品发布片风格（styles/product-keynote）给〔你的产品〕做一支 30 秒的发布片。

what.en: Very slow moves across still photographs, with small serif captions, as in Ken Burns's documentaries.
what.zh: 在老照片上极慢地推拉，配衬线小字，像肯·伯恩斯的纪录片。

for.en: History, biography, how a project came to be.
for.zh: 历史、人物传记、一个项目的来历。

ask.en: Make a 90-second film about [a piece of history] in the archival pan-and-zoom style (styles/archival-pan-zoom).
ask.zh: 用档案推拉风格（styles/archival-pan-zoom）做一支 90 秒的短片，讲〔一段历史〕。

what.en: The subject becomes a place to walk into; the camera keeps moving forward without a cut, and each stop has its own light and weather.
what.zh: 把题目做成一个能走进去的地方，镜头一路往前不剪，每一站一种光、一种天气。

for.en: Mood pieces, journeys through a theme, openings.
for.zh: 意境短片、主题旅程、片头。

ask.en: Make a 60-second journey through [a theme] in the walk-in world style (styles/walk-in-world).
ask.zh: 用走进去的世界风格（styles/walk-in-world）做一支 60 秒的旅程短片，走过〔一个主题〕。

what.en: Inflated liquid-chrome letters on acid yellow, die-cut stickers, everything springing in with a bounce.
what.zh: 充了气的液态铬字，酸黄底、模切贴纸，进场带弹性。

for.en: The playful part of a brand film, tech-meme edits, pop videos, game trailers.
for.zh: 品牌片里好玩的一段、科技梗快剪、流行 MV、游戏预告。

ask.en: Make a 15-second edit for [a new feature] in the Y2K chrome style (styles/y2k-chrome).
ask.zh: 用 Y2K 铬面风格（styles/y2k-chrome）给〔一个新功能〕做一段 15 秒的快剪。
